headline: Weathered Expanse Bleeds Steepest as Godcrofts Goes Wholly Warden
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse now heads the casualty ledger, its hourly losses climbing past thirteen hundred between the armies, the heaviest pace now showing on any front, while Marban Hollow, grimmest in our last edition, has markedly cooled. Base activity has shifted: The Fingers is the freshest sheet, three actions inside two hours at Headsman's Villa, in a region the Colonials hold seven-strong. Godcrofts, busiest over the day with seventeen events, now shows all nine works in Warden hands, Argosa and Lipsia again the hinges. Lykos Isle has tipped the other way, its Warden holdings reduced from four to three against four Colonial after trading at The Squall and Fort Guile. Tempest Island stirred at Blackwatch and Surge Gate mid-morning. The Deadlands and Farranac Coast have filed no base business since early morning, Fishermen's Row nearer fourteen hours silent, though over the full day the Deadlands' toll remains the war's largest. Stlican Shelf bleeds heavily on, eight Warden holdings to one Colonial. This is the ninety-second day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.
